title: List orders page by page
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Each page skips its first order and returns one order too few.
defects.caught_if: a condition lists a known set of orders and checks the first page starts with the first order and holds the full page size
defects.observed: 3 orders, size=2: page 1 returned ids [2]; [1, 2] expected

defects.summary: The page size is never capped at 50.
defects.caught_if: a condition asks for more than 50 per page and checks at most 50 come back (or the request is refused)

defects.summary: Page 0 or a negative page is not rejected; it returns a slice from the end.
defects.caught_if: a condition asks for page 0 and expects status 400
